intro: Find it. Stop it. Then run!!
description:
- Find them. Survive them! -

There was once a mansion said to be plagued by countless paranormal phenomena.

You, an exorcist, enter the mansion to put those disturbances to rest.

However, the spirits lurking within trap you inside the house.

To escape, you must calm every paranormal phenomenon haunting the mansion.

Armed only with sacred talismans used to suppress the phenomena, and candles needed to pacify the spirits, you begin your search.

But the moment you place a talisman, the spirits begin to resist...

Do not overlook any paranormal phenomena.

If you discover a paranormal phenomenon, place a talisman and light the candle at the entrance.

If no paranormal phenomenon is present, do not place a talisman ? simply light the candle.

Calm all seven paranormal phenomena without making a single mistake.

And above all...

"Return safely alive".

●About "Reioku:Ghost house"

"Reioku:Ghost house" is a horror game where you must calm every paranormal phenomenon occurring within the mansion and escape alive.
